correctness.rationale: For separable characteristic-7 quintic F=x^5+a x^2+b x+c, the genus-four differential basis dx/y, x^i dx/y^2 (i=0,1,2) and degree congruent 6 mod7 Cartier extraction give coefficient matrix diag(2b,B) with det B=2b Delta and Disc(F)=Delta, hence det H=4b^2 Delta as polynomial identity. On smooth b=0, rank Cartier is exactly 2 by a nonzero 2x2 minor, a-number=2. Normalize c to 1, A^5=a^5/c^3. Twisted semilinear matrix products have gcd 2x2 minors of P2 equal A^4(A^10-1), gcd entries P3=A, and P3 nonzero at A^5=1; singular A^5=-1 excluded. Thus geometric eventual 7-ranks 0 at A=0,1 at A^5=1,2 elsewhere; smooth b !=0 ordinary rank4. Independent exact SymPy determinant, discriminant and polynomial Euclidean computations reproduced; finite F7/F49 counts are corroboration only.
